newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - March 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - March 6.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on March 6. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Sacked Indonesian legislator Sri Bintang Pamungkas has been detained on charges of subversion for sending Eid al-Fitr celebration cards which urge people to boycott the May 29 general elections. Two other officials from the unrecognised United Democratic Party of Indonesia (PUDI), which Bintang set up last year, were also arrested.
Indonesia recorded a trade surplus of $6.94 billion last year and a 1.05 percent inflation rate for February, Minister of Information Harmoko said.
The construction of a $2.2 billion subway in capital Jakarta will start on June 1. The 14.5 kilometre subway will link Blok M area in South Jakarta and downtown Kota area.
The finance ministry has released a decree allowing Indonesia's pension funds to invest all of their capital in mutual funds.
The military in West Java province is searching for students suspected of producing pamphlets urging Indonesians to boycott the May 29 general elections.
